name: Near
source:
Shiina is an aspiring manga artist.

He's been drawing for fun for a long time, but his efforts just wouldn't pay off.

Just as he was about to stop, he remembered he had a fan.

Near, a boy so beautiful he might as well not have been real.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6208]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
椎名是一位有抱负的漫画家。

很长一段时间以来，他一直以绘画为乐，但他的努力却没有得到回报。

正当他要停下来的时候，他想起自己有一个扇子。

就在附近，一个如此美丽的男孩，他可能不是真实的。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6208]NovelGame[/url]]
